determinism.residual: CPython object identity/ASLR, vDSO clocks and other process-local nondeterminism cannot be made consensus-safe by an in-process import guard or denylist; production therefore refuses open execution until the miner ABI moves to a deterministic VM

image.binding: The operator deployment pins the immutable coretex-memory-evaluator image digest separately and verifies that image contains the exact bootstrap, module, posture, clean source commit and evaluation-law identities
image.reason: The evaluator image is built from the compatibility/evaluation law, so including its digest in the law-bound posture would create a circular build identity

isolation_self_report.marker_emitted: by the inner worker on fd 2 immediately after landlock RESTRICT_SELF returns and BEFORE any candidate byte is imported, so it records what the hardening actually did rather than what the module intends
isolation_self_report.note: the trusted outer launcher classifies the inner's outcome and writes it here; worker.isolation.describe().candidate_filesystem_confinement reads it back as enforced / failed(+reason) / not_observed, never a static claim. A failed install exits 70 before the candidate loads, so the FIRST marker occurrence is authoritative even though a later candidate could forge a copy.

readable: exact copied public view and pack spec
writable: one randomized candidate SQLite output directory

law_identity.note: The prospective evaluation-law descriptor transitively binds the exact content hash of this operational posture, including its bootstrap and containment module hashes. The deployment separately pins the built evaluator image digest; it is not a compatibility-lock member. Containment itself is not silently reused as a runtime ABI or canonical-state root.

process_controls.stderr_forwarding_policy: failure paths only: a bounded (<=1200-byte), printable-ASCII-sanitized tail of the inner worker's stderr, emitted to the launcher's own stderr for the operator record and carried no further by the coordinator (which reads only ok/code/reason). A successful run forwards nothing. The candidate process holds no scorer, gold view or credential, so the tail carries no secret; the hazard it removes is log injection.
process_controls.wasmtime_parallel_compilation_reason: Wasmtime 46's default Rayon compiler pool requires clone/clone3 on first Module compilation. The trusted pre-seccomp bootstrap forces Config.parallel_compilation=false so policy WASM remains executable without weakening the candidate process's fork/clone denial; compilation scheduling changes, WebAssembly validation/fuel/execution semantics do not.
syscall_classes_denied: SysV and POSIX message/semaphore/shared-memory IPC and kernel keyrings
